name: fortnite-treasure-hunters-one-piece-november-1
lines:
يستمر الموسم حتى 5 ديسمبر
بعنوان Treasure Hunters

وتجد فيه قدرات Luffy
و Ace و Zoro و Usopp

وينضم A$AP Rocky
ثم Hatsune Miku
و Kasane Teto
headline:
موسم ONE PIECE في Fortnite
ينطلق في 1 نوفمبر
label: رسمي
note: Epic Games press release (Japanese, quoted in full by Famitsu 30 Oct 13:00Z): Fortnite: Treasure Hunters from 1 Nov to 5 Dec (US time), new 80-player island, ONE PIECE abilities (Luffy, Ace, Zoro, Usopp), weekly captains A$AP Rocky, Lil Uzi Vert, Captain Hatsune Miku, Kasane Teto; battle pass Ace and Robin; shop Luffy, Nami, Usopp. Images: Epic key art from the release, cropped clear of the Japanese logo and the outlet watermark, shown whole.
pace_ok: official stills shown whole hold for their line reading time (4.8 s); no footage outside YouTube
